hits.headline: Meridian Capital Holdings Sdn Bhd Investigated for Money Laundering
hits.excerpt: Regulators have opened a money laundering investigation into Meridian Capital Holdings Sdn Bhd following suspicious transaction reports filed by its bankers.

hits.headline: Money Laundering Probe Opened Into Meridian Capital Holdings
hits.excerpt: Authorities have launched a money laundering investigation into Meridian Capital Holdings Sdn Bhd after several transactions were flagged as suspicious.

hits.headline: Meridian Capital Holdings Sdn Bhd Fined for Regulatory Breach
hits.excerpt: The company was fined RM500,000 for a regulatory breach relating to disclosure requirements under the Companies Act.

hits.headline: Meridian Capital Holdings Sdn Bhd Falls Victim to Embezzlement Scheme
hits.excerpt: The company reported it was the victim of an embezzlement scheme carried out by a former finance manager, and has since reported the matter to police.

hits.headline: Meridian Logistics Pte Ltd Faces Fraud Investigation
hits.excerpt: Singapore-based Meridian Logistics Pte Ltd, unrelated to other Meridian-branded firms, is under a fraud investigation over alleged invoice manipulation.

hits.headline: Meridian Capital Holdings Sdn Bhd Opens New Regional Office
hits.excerpt: Meridian Capital Holdings Sdn Bhd announced the opening of a new office in Kuala Lumpur to support its regional expansion plans.

hits.headline: Clearbrook Consulting Pte Ltd Wins Industry Award
hits.excerpt: The firm was recognized for excellence in advisory services at the annual industry awards.

hits.headline: Clearbrook Consulting Expands Regional Team
hits.excerpt: The company announced several new hires across its Singapore and Malaysia offices.
